examples.arabic: رحت ع الدكان مع ابني عشان نرجع قميص واحد
examples.english: I went to the shop with my son to return one shirt.
examples.transliteration: ruht a dukkan ma ibni ashan nrajje amis wahad
examples.storyTitle: A Shirt for the Whole Family

examples.arabic: لمست قميص أزرق حسيتو كتير ناعم وقلت لازم قيس هاد
examples.english: I touched a blue shirt that felt very soft and said "I must try this one."
examples.transliteration: Lamast qamees azraq haseeto kteer naem w olt lazim qees had

examples.arabic: كان في زلمة لابس قميص ازرق
examples.english: There was a man wearing a blue shirt
examples.transliteration: Kaan fii zalameh laabis qamiis azraq

examples.arabic: بالمحل شافوا قميص ازرق كتير حلو وسارة حبته كتير
examples.english: At the shop, they saw a very nice blue shirt, and Sarah loved it a lot.
examples.transliteration: Bil-maḥall shāfū qamīṣ azraq ktīr ḥilu w Sāra ḥabbatoh ktīr.

examples.arabic: انا اشتريت قميص من المحل مبارح
examples.english: I bought a shirt from the shop yesterday.
examples.transliteration: Ana ishtareet qamees min il-mahall mbarah.

examples.arabic: امبارح اشتريت قميص بس كان قياسه غلط
examples.english: Yesterday I bought a shirt, but it was the wrong size
examples.transliteration: Imbāriḥ ishtarēt qamīṣ bas kān qiyāso ghalaṭ
examples.storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop
